sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Otsego Lake State Park resources via the booking site's /api/resourcelocation/resources, /api/maps and /api/resource/feeDetails for 2027-04-20; audit/state_park_fees/gtc_probe.py, read 2026-10-22)

values.note: Booking site fees by site type (quoted for 2027-04-20): 20/30-amp sites $41 (89 sites), 50-amp $46 (27), 20/30-amp with sewer $51 (32), 50-amp with sewer $56 (12). The DNR rate table lists only the $41 20/30-amp rate for the North and South Loops. Recreation Passport required for entry.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ feeDetails per fee schedule ($41 / $46 / $51 / $56, 2027-04-20) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Otsego Lake, North and South Loops: modern 20/30 AMP $41), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ site attributes (39 sites 'Electrical Service=20 Amps/30 Amps/50 Amps'; 44 sites 'Sewer Hookup=Yes') + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/otsego (tags 'Some campsites with 50-amp service', 'Full-hookup sites'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 160 campsites in the North and South loops; the booking site's equipment lists run to 'Trailer or RV up to 50'' on every site type and 'over 50'' on some of the non-sewer sites. Most sites are within view of Otsego Lake.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/otsego ('Number of sites: 160', 'Pull-through sites available', 'Most sites are generous in size ... within view of Otsego Lake') + midnrreservations.com equipment lists per site, read 2026-10-22

values.note: Modern restrooms with showers and the sanitation station open seasonally, typically mid-May to mid-October; outside that the campground is semi-modern, with vault toilets and a water spigot at park headquarters.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/otsego ('Modern restrooms with showers and a sanitation station are available seasonally, typically mid-May to mid-October. When these are closed for the season, the campground becomes semi-modern and vault toilets are available'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/otsego ('For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online'), read 2026-10-22

summary: DNR park page + booking site: 160 sites, 20/30 A everywhere with 50 A at 39 sites and sewer at 44, pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets/sanitation station seasonally, reservable; fees widened $41 -> $41-56 by site type from the booking site (the DNR rate table lists only $41). Season May 1 - Oct 14 already manual and matching. Park banner: 'Sites 34-83 reopened, concessions closed for the season' (construction; campground open). Water at the sewer sites not stated as a site attribute; left unknown.
flags: Missing operator website: the entry links only the bare reservation home page; the park's DNR page is https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/otsego.
Missing phone: DNR lists 989-732-5485 for the park.
